review_candidates.title: AI Engineer
review_candidates.description: About Zetta: Zetta is a global technology company designing secure, AI-enabled platforms for high-impact industries, logistics, transportation, and essential services. At Zetta, we don’t just consult. We build. We deploy. AI-Enabled Work Environment: Zetta is an AI-enabled organization. Candidates are expected to demonstrate familiarity with modern AI tools and the ability to use them responsibly to improve productivity, problem-solving, and decision-making within their role. Role Overview: We are looking for an AI Engineer to design and build production-grade software solutions where AI is a core engineering capability. AI is the primary focus of this role, but the position is not limited to building standalone AI products. The ideal candidate can combine AI, software engineering, data, APIs, automation, and integrations to solve complex business and operational problems and can move from prototype to reliable production implementation. What You Will Work On: AI-enabled applications, intelligent workflows, and enterprise automation. Agentic and multi-agent systems. Retrieval-Augmented Generation, enterprise search, and knowledge systems. Document intelligence and structured/unstructured data processing. AI integrations with databases, APIs, internal platforms, and third-party systems. Backend services, automation, operational tools, and AI-powered platform capabilities. AI evaluation, observability, reliability, performance, security, and cost optimization. Key Responsibilities: Design, develop, test, and deploy production-grade AI solutions. Build AI into broader software solutions where it creates measurable value. Develop agentic and multi-agent systems with tools, skills, orchestration, and state management. Implement RAG pipelines across structured and unstructured enterprise data. Design prompts, system instructions, context strategies, structured outputs, and tool/function calling. Develop backend services and APIs primarily using Python. Integrate AI solutions with databases, APIs, enterprise platforms, document repositories, and internal systems. Build document ingestion, chunking, metadata, indexing, retrieval, and permission-aware access mechanisms. Design evaluation approaches for response quality, retrieval quality, hallucination risk, task completion, latency, reliability, and cost. Implement logging, monitoring, traces, observability, and auditability. Optimize AI systems for production performance and cost. Troubleshoot issues across AI, application code, databases, integrations, and infrastructure. Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Data, DevOps, QA, and Security. Convert successful implementations into reusable platform capabilities rather than one-off solutions. Required Qualifications: 2+ years of professional software engineering or AI engineering experience . Strong professional experience with Python and solid software engineering fundamentals. Hands-on experience building production applications using Large Language Models. Strong understanding of LLMs, RAG, embeddings, semantic search, prompt engineering, context engineering, structured outputs, tool calling, agentic workflows, and AI evaluation. Strong experience building backend services and REST APIs. Strong SQL skills and experience with PostgreSQL or similar relational databases. Experience integrating third-party and enterprise APIs. Experience working with both structured and unstructured data. Experience with Docker and containerized applications. Cloud deployment experience, preferably GCP . Git and CI/CD experience. Strong debugging and production troubleshooting skills. Preferred Experience: OpenAI APIs and models. Google Vertex AI. Multi-agent and orchestration frameworks. Vector databases, vector search, or pgvector. Redis. TypeScript, JavaScript, or Node.js. n8n or comparable workflow automation platforms. Kubernetes / GKE. Jira, Bitbucket, Slack, and enterprise SaaS integrations. Document processing for PDF, DOCX, spreadsheets, and other enterprise formats. AI observability and tracing platforms. OAuth, OIDC, SSO, RBAC, IAM, and enterprise security concepts. Experience operating AI solutions in regulated or enterprise environments. What We Are Looking For: We are looking for an engineer who combines AI depth with strong software engineering discipline . The right candidate should be able to decide where AI adds value and where traditional engineering is the better approach. They should be comfortable moving through Problem → Architecture → Prototype → Engineering → Integration → Evaluation → Production → Monitoring → Improvement . What Success Looks Like: AI solutions work reliably in production, not only in demos. Systems are useful, secure, measurable, observable, maintainable, and economically sustainable, and successful implementations become reusable capabilities that strengthen the broader platform. What We Offer: Medical insurance coverage. Course and certification tuition reimbursement. Flexible Working Hours Fully Remote Work Environment A collaborative, growth-oriented environment that encourages ownership and impact. Competitive USD Salary The opportunity to contribute to a global, technology-driven organization with a strong people-first culture. Equal Opportunity Statement: Zetta is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

review_candidates.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Platform)
review_candidates.company: MCS Group | Your Specialist Recruitment Consultancy
review_candidates.description: Senior Backend Engineer Belfast | Hybrid | Permanent | Senior We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join a small, highly technical Platform team building and scaling a critical technology platform. The role is around 90% backend , but the team typically hires strong full-stack engineers , so some frontend experience would be a nice bonus. The Tech The core stack is: TypeScript / Node.js/ AWS Microservices Kubernetes / Docker Event-driven architecture SQL and other data stores There is also some Go and Python , although Go isn't essential. We're open on backend languages if you have strong engineering fundamentals and can demonstrate you've successfully picked up new languages before. What you'll be doing This is a role with a lot of ownership. You'll be involved in designing, building and running backend services rather than simply picking up tickets. You'll be expected to: Design and build scalable backend services and APIs. Contribute to architecture and system design . Work with databases and understand why different data stores are used. Think about application and API security . Troubleshoot performance and production issues , including things like CPU, memory and latency. Understand how your services are deployed, monitored and maintained in production. What we're looking for Around 5+ years' engineering experience with strong backend development experience. The key thing is technical depth rather than ticking every technology box . We want someone who can talk confidently about a system they've built - how it was architected, why decisions were made, what data stores were used, how it was secured, where the bottlenecks were and how they dealt with issues once it was live. The Team You'll join a small team of around 4-5 engineers , predominantly Senior level. There's no dedicated DevOps engineer within the team, so engineers take ownership of the services they build, including deployment, monitoring and troubleshooting. It's a good fit for someone who enjoys ownership, problem-solving and modern engineering , rather than needing lots of day-to-day direction. A few extras 15% bonus £400 lifestyle allowance Clear engineering career progression Flexible hybrid working, typically 3 days in the Belfast office Opportunity to work with AI and emerging technology as the platform evolves If you're a strong backend engineer who enjoys understanding how systems actually work , solving problems and having a real influence on architecture, we'd be keen to hear from you. Rachael Walker r.walker@mcsgroup.jobs 02896935487
